description: Starting templates for setting up an organization's inventory: per kind of organization a category tree with custom field definitions, typical locations, quantity-tracked consumable examples, naming conventions and the questions that shape a setup. Without arguments: the template catalog (id, title, org-type fit, summary). With templateId: the full template, whose structured slices match the scaffold_categories / scaffold_locations inputs, with names as {en, de, fr, es, it} records. Pure product data: it reads nothing from the organization and writes nothing.
